wantToWatch.title: The Other Guys
wantToWatch.overview: Unlike their heroic counterparts on the force, desk-bound NYPD detectives Gamble and Hoitz garner no headlines as they work day to day. When a seemingly minor case turns out to be a big deal, the two cops get the opportunity to finally prove to their comrades that they have the right stuff.

wantToWatch.title: Scary Movie
wantToWatch.overview: A familiar-looking group of teenagers find themselves being stalked by a more-than-vaguely recognizable masked killer! As the victims begin to pile up and the laughs pile on, none of your favorite scary movies escape the razor-sharp satire of this outrageously funny parody!

wantToWatch.title: Scary Movie 2
wantToWatch.overview: A group of students visit a mansion called "Hell House," and murderous high jinks ensue.

wantToWatch.title: Scary Movie 3
wantToWatch.overview: News anchorwoman Cindy Campbell has to investigate mysterious crop circles and killing video tapes, and help the President stop an alien invasion in the process.

wantToWatch.title: Scary Movie 4
wantToWatch.overview: Cindy finds out the house she lives in is haunted by a little boy and goes on a quest to find out who killed him and why. Also, Alien "Tr-iPods" are invading the world and she has to uncover the secret in order to stop them.

wantToWatch.title: Scary Movie 5
wantToWatch.overview: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities. Determined to expel the insidious force, they install security cameras and discover their family is being stalked by an evil dead demon.

wantToWatch.title: Scary Movie
wantToWatch.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

wantToWatch.title: Epic Movie
wantToWatch.overview: When the Pevensie siblings each follow their own path, they find themselves at Willy's Chocolate Factory. Walking through a wardrobe, they discover the world of Gnarnia, ruled by the White Bitch. Meeting up with characters such as Harry Potter and Captain Jack Swallows, the newly reunited family must team up with Aslo, a wise-but-horny lion to stop the White Bitch's army.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination
wantToWatch.overview: After a teenager has a terrifying vision of him and his friends dying in a plane crash, he prevents the accident only to have Death hunt them down, one by one.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination 2
wantToWatch.overview: When Kimberly has a violent premonition of a highway pileup she blocks the freeway, keeping a few others meant to die, safe...Or are they? The survivors mysteriously start dying and it's up to Kimberly to stop it before she's next.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination 5
wantToWatch.overview: Death is just as omnipresent as ever, and is unleashed after one man’s premonition saves a group of coworkers from a terrifying suspension bridge collapse. But this group of unsuspecting souls was never supposed to survive, and, in a terrifying race against time, the ill-fated group frantically tries to discover a way to escape Death’s sinister agenda.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination
wantToWatch.overview: When Murph has a premonition of a breakroom bloodbath, it sets off a chain of deadly events in the CollegeHumor offices. They can run, but they can't hide.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
wantToWatch.overview: Plagued by a violent recurring nightmare, college student Stefanie heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination 3
wantToWatch.overview: High school senior Wendy's premonition of a deadly rollercoaster ride saves her life and a lucky few, but not from death itself — which seeks out those who escaped their fate.

wantToWatch.title: The Final Destination
wantToWatch.overview: A horrifying premonition saves a young man and his friends from death during a racetrack accident but terrible fates await them nonetheless.

wantToWatch.title: Final Destination 7
wantToWatch.overview: The seventh installment in the Final Destination franchise. Plot TBA.
